units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 8. The procedure for paying financial assistance from the civil servants' payroll fund shall be determined by the relevant regulations approved by the employer's representative.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 8.1. In cases provided for by this Federal Law in which civil servants retain monetary remuneration or are paid monetary compensation, federal civil servants' monetary remuneration shall be calculated under the procedure determined by the Government of the Russian Federation; for civil servants of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, it shall be calculated under a regulatory legal act of that constituent entity, taking into account the provisions of the procedure determined by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 8.1 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 9. In cases established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, a regional coefficient (coefficient) shall apply to a civil servant's monetary remuneration.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 10. Civil servants shall receive other payments provided for by the relevant federal laws and other regulatory legal acts.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 11. Remuneration salaries for federal civil service positions shall be increased (indexed) annually in accordance with the federal law on the federal budget for the relevant year, taking into account inflation (consumer prices). The decision to increase (index) remuneration salaries for federal civil service positions shall be made by the President of the Russian Federation on the proposal of the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 12. Remuneration salaries for civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be increased (indexed) annually in accordance with that constituent entity's law on its budget for the relevant year, taking into account inflation (consumer prices). The increase (indexation) of remuneration salaries for civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be carried out in accordance with that constituent entity's legislation.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 13. Federal civil servants holding civil service positions in a state body located outside the territory of the Russian Federation shall be paid monetary remuneration in foreign currency and in rubles under the procedure and at the rates established by the President of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 14. A special remuneration procedure may be established for certain civil service positions, under which remuneration depends on indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of professional service activities specified in a fixed-term service contract. The remuneration conditions established by other parts of this Article shall not apply to civil servants paid under that special procedure. Generalized indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of state bodies' activities, the adoption and implementation of managerial and other decisions, and legal, organizational and documentation support for implementation of those decisions, common to state bodies and civil servants, shall be approved respectively by the President of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 15. The list of civil service positions for which a special remuneration procedure may be established, and the procedure for determining civil servants' remuneration provided for in part 14 of this Article, shall be approved respectively by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation on the proposal of the Government of the Russian Federation and by regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 16. Remuneration provided for in part 14 of this Article shall be paid within the established civil servants' payroll fund.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 17. Specific indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of a state body's activities, the adoption and implementation of managerial and other decisions, and legal, organizational and documentation support for implementation of those decisions shall be approved by a legal act of the state body in accordance with the particular features of its tasks and functions.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.text: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.label: Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.text: 1. The civil servants' payroll fund and the payroll fund for employees holding positions that are not civil service positions shall together constitute the payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.text: 2. When forming state bodies' civil servants' payroll funds, provision shall be made for funds to make the payments established by parts 2 and 5 of Article 50 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.text: 3. Payroll funds for federal civil servants of federal state bodies and for civil servants of constituent entities of the Russian Federation serving in state bodies of those constituent entities shall be formed from the respective budgets' funds allocated to finance payments established by parts 2 and 5 of Article 50 of this Federal Law, and to finance:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.text: 1) payment of the regional coefficient (coefficient) in cases established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, at the rates established respectively by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.text: 2) payment in certain state bodies of increased monetary remuneration, the amount of which shall be established respectively by the President of the Russian Federation and by a regulatory legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.text: 3) other payments established respectively by this Federal Law, other federal laws, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.text: 4. The procedure for forming payroll funds for federal civil servants of federal state bodies, specifying the number of position salaries (on an annual basis) used to determine the amount of funds allocated to payments established by parts 2 and 5 of Article 50 of this Federal Law, shall be approved by the President of the Russian Federation on the proposal of the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.text: 5. In state bodies where civil servants are remunerated in accordance with part 14 of Article 50 of this Federal Law, the civil servants' payroll fund (or the relevant part of it) shall be formed on the basis of indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of the state body's activities.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.text: 6. The procedure for forming payroll funds for employees of federal state bodies holding positions that are not federal civil service positions shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.text: 7. Payroll funds for civil servants and employees holding positions that are not civil service positions in the public authorities of the Sirius federal territory, the control and accounts body of the Sirius federal territory and the territorial electoral commission of the Sirius federal territory shall be formed in accordance with parts 1, 2, 3 (except point 1) and 4–6 of this Article.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
units.text: 8. The procedure for forming payroll funds for civil servants of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation serving in its state bodies and payroll funds for employees holding positions that are not civil service positions of that constituent entity shall be established by the constituent entity's legislation, taking into account the provisions of the regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Russian Federation provided for in parts 4 and 6 of this Article.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 51

units.locator: Chapter 11. STATE GUARANTEES IN CIVIL SERVICE
units.text: Chapter 11. STATE GUARANTEES IN CIVIL SERVICE
units.label: Chapter 11. STATE GUARANTEES IN CIVIL SERVICE

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.label: Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 1. To ensure civil servants' legal and social protection, increase their motivation to perform official duties effectively, strengthen the stability of the professional civil service personnel complement, and compensate for the restrictions established by this Federal Law and other federal laws, civil servants shall be guaranteed:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 1) equal remuneration conditions and comparable indicators for evaluating the effectiveness of professional service activity results when holding corresponding civil service positions, unless otherwise established by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 2) the civil servant's right to receive monetary remuneration on time and in full;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 3) civil service conditions that ensure the performance of official duties in accordance with the official duties regulations;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 4) rest ensured by establishing normal service hours, granting weekly rest days and non-working public holidays, and granting basic and additional annual paid leave;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 5) medical insurance for the civil servant and their family members, including after retirement on a length-of-service pension, in accordance with this Federal Law and the federal law on medical insurance for state servants of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 6) compulsory state social insurance against illness or loss of capacity for work during civil service, or retention of monetary remuneration during temporary incapacity for work and while undergoing examination in a medical organization providing specialized medical care, in accordance with federal law;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 7) payments under compulsory state insurance in the cases, under the procedure and at the rates established respectively by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 8) reimbursement of expenses connected with official business trips. The procedure and conditions for sending a civil servant on business trips shall be established respectively by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation and by regulatory legal acts of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 9) reimbursement of expenses connected with relocation of a civil servant and their family members to another locality when, at the initiative of the employer's representative, the civil servant is transferred to another civil service position in the same or another state body. The procedure and conditions for reimbursing the civil servant's expenses shall be established respectively by a Resolution of the Government of the Russian Federation and by regulatory legal acts of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 9.1) when a civil servant is appointed by rotation to a civil service position in a state body located in another locality within the Russian Federation, reimbursement, from the funds of the state body to which the civil servant is assigned by rotation, of expenses connected with relocation of the civil servant and their family members to the place of civil service in another locality within the Russian Federation; and reimbursement, from the funds of the state body in which the civil servant last held a civil service position, of expenses connected with relocation of the civil servant and their family members to another locality within the Russian Federation after termination of the fixed-term service contract or release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service. The expenses provided for in this point shall be reimbursed under the procedure and conditions established for reimbursement of expenses connected with relocation of a civil servant and their family members to another locality within the Russian Federation when the civil servant is transferred to another state body;
units.label: Point 9.1 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 9.2) provision of official accommodation to a civil servant appointed by rotation to a civil service position in a state body located in another locality within the Russian Federation, or, if official accommodation is unavailable at the new place of civil service, reimbursement of the civil servant's expenses for renting (subletting) accommodation. If the civil servant is the tenant of accommodation under a social tenancy agreement at the previous place of civil service, that agreement may not be terminated at the landlord's request during the term of the fixed-term service contract for holding a civil service position by rotation. The procedure and conditions for providing official accommodation to federal civil servants and the procedure and rates for reimbursing their expenses for renting (subletting) accommodation shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation; the procedure and conditions for providing official accommodation to civil servants of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and the procedure and rates for reimbursing their expenses for renting (subletting) accommodation shall be established by regulatory legal acts of those constituent entities;
units.label: Point 9.2 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 10) protection of the civil servant and their family members against violence, threats and other unlawful acts connected with the performance of official duties, in the cases, under the procedure and subject to the conditions established by federal law;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 11) state pension provision under the procedure and conditions established by the federal law on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have performed state service and their families.
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 1.1. Regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation, the Government of the Russian Federation or a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may provide civil servants appointed (being appointed) by rotation to civil service positions in state bodies located in other localities within the Russian Federation with other guarantees in addition to those provided for in points 9.1 and 9.2 of part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 2. If a civil servant is released from the position held in connection with election or appointment to a state office, election to an elective office in a local self-government body, or election (delegation) to a paid elective position in a trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body, the conditions of that civil servant's pension provision shall be determined at their choice.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 3. Civil servants shall also be provided with other state guarantees established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.label: Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: Subject to certain conditions provided for by this Federal Law or other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, or by laws or other regulatory legal acts of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, civil servants may be granted the right to:
units.label: Art. 53 · “Subject to certain conditions provided for by this Federal Law…”

units.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 1) further professional education with retention of the civil service position held and monetary remuneration for that period;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 2) transport services in connection with the performance of official duties, depending on the category and group of the civil service position held, as well as compensation for the use of personal transport for official purposes and reimbursement of related expenses, in the cases and under the procedure established respectively by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 3) holding another civil service position in the event of reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body, in accordance with Article 31 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 4) a one-time subsidy for purchasing residential premises, once during the entire period of civil service, under the procedure and conditions established respectively by a Resolution of the Government of the Russian Federation and a regulatory legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 4.1) the guarantees provided for in Article 53.1 of this Federal Law in connection with the civil servant's conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4.1 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 5) other state guarantees.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 53.1

units.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. Civil servants conscripted for military service upon mobilization, assigned to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or having concluded a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime (hereinafter in this Article, military service), or a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, shall be guaranteed retention of their civil service positions for the period of military service or provision of voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation. During that period, civil service shall be suspended and monetary remuneration shall neither accrue nor be paid.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 53.1

units.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1.1. Civil service shall be suspended and resumed under the procedure and conditions provided for by the Federal Law ‘On the State Service System of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 53.1

units.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. During military service or provision of voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, the service contract may not be terminated at the initiative of the employer's representative, except in connection with abolition of the state body (public authority of a federal territory).
units.label: Part 2 Art. 53.1

units.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2.1. For the period of military service or provision of voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, the running of the term of a fixed-term service contract shall be suspended, except for a fixed-term service contract concluded for the performance of a specific assignment or for replacing an absent civil servant whose civil service position is retained under federal laws.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 53.1

units.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2.2. A fixed-term service contract whose term was suspended in the case provided for in part 2.1 of this Article shall resume for a period equal to the remainder of its term calculated as at the date of suspension, but not beyond the civil servant's attainment of the maximum age for civil service unless their civil service term has been extended in accordance with Article 25.1 of this Federal Law, except for a fixed-term service contract concluded for a civil service position in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category. A fixed-term service contract concluded for a civil service position in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category shall resume for a period not exceeding the term of office of the person holding a state office, head of a state body, head of a territorial body of a federal executive body or head of a state body's representative office whom the civil servant holding a position in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category assists. Upon expiry of the term of office of the person holding a state office, head of a state body, head of a territorial body of a federal executive body or head of a state body's representative office whom the civil servant holding a position in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category assists, or upon the civil servant's attainment of the maximum age for civil service unless their civil service term has been extended in accordance with Article 25.1 of this Federal Law, the term of that civil servant's fixed-term service contract shall not resume, except for a civil servant assisting a person holding a state office, where the state-service relations with that civil servant have been extended under the procedure provided for in Article 25.1 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2.2 Art. 53.1

units.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. A civil servant who has completed military service or provision of voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation shall, upon application, be granted annual paid leave at any time convenient to them within six months after resuming civil service.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 53.1

units.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 4. The period of military service or provision of voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation shall count towards length of civil service.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 53.1

units.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 5. The provisions of labour legislation shall apply to legal relations not regulated by this Article.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 53.1

units.locator: Article 54. Length of civil service
units.text: Article 54. Length of civil service
units.label: Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Length of civil service
units.text: 1. Length (total duration) of civil service shall include periods of holding:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Length of civil service
units.text: 1) civil service positions, military positions and positions in other types of federal state service;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Length of civil service
units.text: 2) state offices;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Length of civil service
units.text: 3) municipal offices;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 54
